ValidationRule.description: This is to ensure a Product is selected all time during complaint lifecycle, except via shell case conversion hence not included isnew and only trigger when its changed from Escalated status
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, !ISNEW(), OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Customer_Complaint', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Non_Customer_Complaint' ), ISCHANGED(Status), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status), 'Escalated') , NOT(ISCHANGED(RecordTypeId)), NOT(ISBLANK(IDR_Inbox_Email_Address__c)), ISBLANK(Product__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Product or service name is mandatory
